== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The [[Damascan royal army]] is the military force serving the Kingdom of [[Damasca]]. Rather than following a single Overlord, these soldiers serve the kingdom as a whole. They are recognizable by their red-and-gold clothing and utilize organized formations, such as circular squads of men equipped with shields and spears. In combat, they use vocal commands to coordinate their movements. Their arsenal includes various weapons, armor, and [[steel]], as well as the summoning of automatons to crush enemies. The army has been involved in significant historical conflicts, including pitched battles against [[Valinhall]] and wars in [[Cana]]. Recently, the military has been mobilizing to attack the city of [[Enosh]], having spent years and several weeks building up weaponry across various territories for this purpose.}}
